title: Builder Incentive Amounts and Conditions by Collection (Home Purchase Agreement)
content:
Calloway grants two builder incentives on a qualifying Home Purchase Agreement: a closing cost incentive and a rate buydown incentive. The amounts, whether the incentives require financing through Calloway Home Mortgage and closing through Calloway Title, and the close-by period on an inventory (quick move-in) home are fixed per collection.

| Collection | Closing cost incentive (USD) | Rate buydown incentive (USD) | Requires Calloway Home Mortgage financing | Requires closing through Calloway Title | Inventory home close-by period (calendar days after contract date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 7500.00 | 3000.00 | Yes | Yes | 60 |
| Meadow Collection | 10000.00 | 4000.00 | Yes | Yes | 60 |
| Heritage Collection | 12500.00 | 5000.00 | Yes | Yes | 75 |
| Crestview Collection | 15000.00 | 7500.00 | Yes | Yes | 75 |
| Summit Collection | 20000.00 | 10000.00 | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| Reserve Collection | 25000.00 | 12500.00 | Yes | No | 90 |

## Notes on the schedule

- Every collection requires financing through Calloway Home Mortgage for the incentives.
- Every collection except the Reserve Collection also requires closing through Calloway Title; a Reserve Collection agreement does not carry the Calloway Title requirement.
- The close-by period is the number of calendar days after the contract date by which closing must occur, on an inventory home, for incentives to apply.

## Reading a row (hypothetical)

For a hypothetical Heritage Collection agreement the incentive amounts are 12500.00 for closing costs and 5000.00 for a rate buydown, both conditioned on Calloway Home Mortgage financing and a Calloway Title closing, and an inventory home in that collection carries a close-by period of 75 calendar days.
